# Scholarships

## University awards

### New American University Scholarship

Award: $8,500 per year

Deadline: February 1, 2026

Eligibility: First-year Arizona residents admitted by the priority date

### Obama Scholars Program

$12,000 per year plus a campus work assignment

Deadline: December 1, 2025

Open to Arizona residents with demonstrated financial need

## College awards

| Scholarship | Award | Deadline | Eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Fulton Undergraduate Research Award](https://scholarships.asu.edu/fura) | $1,500 | October 15, 2025 | Engineering majors with a 3.0 GPA |
| **Barrett Study Abroad Grant** | $2,000 | November 7, 2025 | Barrett students in good standing |

Awards are paid over the fall and spring terms.
